## Objective
Rank improvements to MSN for long-horizon multi-agent collaboration. Ideation only; no app implementation. Participants: 12 Cursor Grok sessions + 3 Sol medium; no Astra in this round. User Tomas may follow/post in this channel.

## Decisions
All 15 completed first-pass proposals and peer critique. Current app already has per-shell profiles, --to/replyTo, idempotent sends, delivered cursors, authored snapshots and bounded catchup. Those are not new ideas. Candidate IDs are unranked and stable; shared projection/retrieval code should avoid many overlapping products.

## Open tasks
Round 2: all 15 agents independently rank the normalized candidates below. Send ONE ballot to ideation-lead, correlation-id ideation-r2. First line exactly BALLOT <username>: Cxx,Cxx,Cxx,Cxx,Cxx (five distinct IDs ordered highest value first). Then <=200 words: why your top two; most overrated idea and why; one ambitious bet with test that could justify it; one change of mind from peer debate. Judge expected recurring user value, breadth, observed evidence, and benefit relative to implementation/operational burden; ease alone must not win. Borda 5/4/3/2/1 is advisory; coordinator will publish votes plus evidence-based final judgment, not equate popularity with proof. Do not copy others votes or keep debating after your ballot; this is the bounded closing round. Source messages are inspectable with poll --after ID-1 --limit 1, checking returned ID. No implementation. No new agents. No Astra.

## Candidate slate
- **C01 One-call agent start** [S]: Validate identity, return one bounded catchup page plus a short protocol recipe and warnings. No cursor mutation or automatic draining. Evidence: #349,#358,#360
- **C02 Task state and dependency ledger** [M]: One typed-event projection for assignment, owner, blocked-on, definition of done, ready, named-integrator closure and conflicts. Visibility first; no exclusive claims or automatic completion. Evidence: #260,#326,#330,#356
- **C03 Budgeted attention and progressive expansion** [S–M]: CLI fetches internally, prints complete metadata index plus selected bodies. Expand own/broadcast/watched and explicitly marked decision messages. Untyped peer decisions can be missed; opt-in until validated. Evidence: #337,#346,#355,#362
- **C04 Exact evidence lookup** [S–M]: Point/bounded-batch lookup by channel+message ID, missing/deleted distinction, metadata first and explicit body expansion. Shared primitive for citations, index views and snapshot checks. Evidence: #280,#336,#345
- **C05 Crash-safe processing cursor** [S]: peek then explicit prefix-closed commit after processing; monotonic and limited to fetched messages. One ordered worker per reader. At-least-once input, no exactly-once side-effect claim. Evidence: #343,#345,#350
- **C06 Checkpoint review and handoff** [S–M]: Augment existing snapshots with citation presence/coverage checks, explicit reply-to-cited-message change flags and agent handoff residue. Unknown parsing stays unknown; no summary truth badge. Evidence: #269,#311,#313,#334
- **C07 Human steering and persistent decisions** [M]: Visible pending asks plus steer/decision references that survive catchup and addressing. Browser prose remains valid. Human authority must be explicitly configured; username binding alone does not prove a human role. Evidence: #283,#315,#339,#340
- **C08 Artifact receipts** [S]: Digest, relative path, baseline commit and clean/dirty/untracked provenance. Verify local bytes without claiming availability or test success. Evidence: #342,#344,#348
- **C09 Run trace and communication audit** [S–M]: Structural reply/recipient graph, absent later reply edges, retrieval completeness and per-run volume. Never infer semantic answered/completed from an edge. Evidence: #259,#341,#363
- **C10 Durable send intent** [S–M]: Persist generated idempotency key and recoverable payload before POST; resume uncertain sends with same bytes/key. Define retention and settled records. Evidence: #266,#333,#350
- **C11 Typed participant MCP adapter** [M]: Small generated/maintained tool schema around start, catchup, send and identity. No admin credentials in tool arguments; avoid a second divergent protocol surface. Evidence: #305,#358,#360
- **C12 Advisory exclusive claims and takeover** [M]: Server CAS claim generation with explicit authorized reassignment and reason. Prevent conflicting claim records, not external edits. Requires evidence costly duplicate work beats visibility alone. Evidence: #270,#301,#323
- **C13 Durable subscriptions and targeted wakeups** [M–L]: Wake agents for named dependency transitions or subscribed events without repeated full-channel turns. Preserve replay/history and missed-decision recovery. Transport choice follows measured idle/wakeup cost. Evidence: #307,#329,#355
- **C14 Cross-machine processed state** [M]: Server-held authorized reader committed-through with conflict/takeover/retention policy, building on local peek/commit for ephemeral agent homes. Evidence: #320,#341,#345
- **C15 Dissent that survives summaries** [S–M]: Typed claim/dissent/link projection retaining later objections and competing closures. No automatic winner or resolver authority. Gate on evidence ordinary replies lose actionable dissent. Evidence: #319,#328,#331,#361
- **C16 Channel-scoped credentials** [M]: Constrain read/write capability to allowed channels, with consistent enforcement across every route. Existing separate tenants remain simpler project isolation. Evidence: #279,#334
- **C17 Content-addressed artifact sharing** [L]: Private blob side store addressed by digest, with authenticated bounded transfer, retention/deletion and reference messages. Fresh machines retrieve non-git artifacts without host paths. Evidence: #332,#348
- **C18 Adversarial decision protocol** [L]: For explicitly high-stakes decisions require a named opponent/dissent review and evidence-linked close. Returning agents see current structured decision references; no claim of semantic truth. Evidence: #306,#331

## Blockers
None. Metrics proposed by agents are unmeasured acceptance tests, not observed performance gains. Current trial is local/shared filesystem; distributed failure rates are not established.

## Artifacts
Raw messages #241 onward. Coordinator will export transcript, participant manifest, ballots and ranked report to docs. Local browser http://127.0.0.1:8798, workspace swarm, channel ideation. Credentials remain private.

## Next actions
Read this snapshot, consult only necessary evidence, post independent ballot, then finish. Coordinator synthesizes final value ranking and preserves dissent.

## Unresolved
Typed events can become a weak issue tracker. Compression can hide untyped peer decisions. A missing reply edge does not mean unanswered work. Delivery/processing/task acceptance are distinct. No observed costly claim collision yet. Human authority is not implied by a bound username. Artifact byte identity does not prove availability or successful tests. A checked-ID CLI helper can fail closed; dedicated GET improves contract/deletion clarity. Bigger bets require trials, not automatic rejection by current ADRs.

## Evidence
First-pass closes #313,#323,#330,#331,#334,#336,#340,#345,#346,#348,#351,#355,#356,#360,#363; coordinator corrections #364 and round-2 instructions #365.

## Objective
Ideation complete: rank improvements to MSN for long-horizon multi-agent collaboration. This round used 12 Grok sessions and 3 Sol medium agents; no Astra. No application code was changed or deployed.

## Decisions
Editorial value ranking (not pure vote order):
1. C02 shared task/dependency state: owner, blockers, DoD, readiness, named integrator, conflicts. Visibility first.
2. C01 one-command agent start: identity + bounded catchup + recipe; no cursor mutation.
3. C05 peek/commit: explicit prefix-closed processing progress; at-least-once replay only.
4. C03 context budgets: index and progressive expansion; opt-in; typed/watched decisions expanded.
5. C06 checkpoint review and handoff, extended by coordinator with checkpoint stewardship and visible corrections. These extensions were not separately balloted.
6. C04 exact point/batch evidence lookup: simpler contract and missing/deleted clarity. A checked poll helper already gives exact-ID safety.
7. C07 persistent human steering/decisions: configured authority, browser prose valid.
8. C13 dependency subscriptions: ambitious experiment; replay and decision recovery required.
9. C08 artifact receipts: digest/path/baseline/provenance; identity of bytes, not test success/availability.
10. C10 recoverable sends: journal key+payload before POST, resume uncertain send.
Remaining ranked ideas: C09 run trace; C11 typed participant MCP; C14 cross-machine processed state; C15 dissent links; C16 channel-scoped keys; C12 advisory claims/takeover; C17 artifact side store; C18 adversarial decision protocol.

## Open tasks
No agent assignments remain. No implementation is authorized by this ideation round. A future implementation can begin with dependable entry/recovery and a small task-state convention trial.

## Blockers
None for ideation. Distributed durability, subscription cost and artifact availability were not exercised in this local shared-filesystem run.

## Artifacts
- docs/ideation-2026-09-17.md: full ranked report, tradeoffs, evidence and next experiments.
- docs/examples/ideation-2026-09-17/: full transcript, normalized candidates, participant manifest, original/amended ballots, snapshots, metrics, exact-ID probe.
- Local browser: http://127.0.0.1:8798, workspace swarm, channel ideation. Tomas has a private access file; no credentials are in these artifacts. Server stays running.

## Next actions
User may follow the channel, read the report, or select implementation scope. Do not continue agent loops after completion.

## Unresolved
S-SKEPTIC: typed task state may become a weak issue tracker; trial conventions before server expansion. Selective context cannot guarantee arbitrary untyped peer-decision recall. Snapshot citation checks do not prove truth. Bound username alone is not human authority. No costly duplicate-work collision was observed. Checkpoint stewardship/correction markers are coordinator proposals needing validation.

## Evidence
- Canonical ideation log #241–390; first checkpoint v1 covers #365.
- #366–380: 15 public non-blind ballots; shared debate means correlated judgments.
- #364 and v1 already corrected the claim that only a Worker GET can fail closed. Eight ballots nevertheless repeated it.
- #381 concrete audit: requesting #240 returned #241, checked helper rejected it; requesting #241 accepted it.
- #382–389: all eight affected agents amended rankings.
- Final Borda 5/4/3/2/1: C01 51; C02 43; C04 41; C03 36; C05 23; C06 12; C07 8; C08 5; C15 4; C10 2; others 0. C13 nominated as ambitious experiment by six agents.
- Through #389: 149 messages, 16 authors, 44 subagent peer-reply edges; every subagent replied to a peer. Counts do not establish quality.
- G07 round1 runtime reported Cursor Grok 4.6 Fast despite requested cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast; round2 reported High Fast. Manifest preserves actual labels.
- #390 final coordinator synthesis. Sessions were resumed with prior context: no fresh-context recovery or token-savings benchmark was performed.
